blocks.p: The Gardener removes randomness from the setup.

ul: The Storyteller chooses which player is which character.
The normal setup rules must be followed.
The purpose of the Gardener is not to allow players to choose their character, but instead to allow the Storyteller to craft a specific style of game or logic puzzle.

blocks.p: During setup, instead of putting the character tokens in the bag, put them face-down on the Town Square, or a firm object like a book, in a circle or shape that matches the physical seating arrangement. One at a time, in clockwise order, prompt the players to take the token that corresponds with their physical seating position.

blocks.example: The Storyteller wants to set up a game that has the {c:wraith}, {c:lordoftyphon}, {c:cerenovus}, {c:zealot}, {c:monk}, {c:alsaahir}, {c:banshee}, {c:highpriestess}, and {c:balloonist}. The Storyteller sets up these characters in this order, places them face down, and the players take their tokens. Ben is the {c:lordoftyphon} and Julian is the {c:highpriestess}.
